issues.description: Numeric threshold for the filter on the attribute Gemeinde.einwohner_w differs between the problem statement and the solution: the problem statement (Aufgabe 04) requires counting Schwimmbäder in Gemeinden with more than 1000 female inhabitants (Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000), whereas the solution implementation in solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql uses Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 2000. This discrepancy produces different query results and will confuse students about the correct condition to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the threshold consistent. Either update solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql line 4 to use 'AND Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000' so the solution matches the problem statement, or if the intended threshold is 2000, update problem_statement.md (line 31) to state 'mehr als 2000 weiblichen Einwohnerinnen'. Prefer changing the solution to > 1000 to match the current problem description: replace 'AND Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 2000' with 'AND Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000'.
